tasks.label: SIL: wait for Renode GDB server
tasks.command: timeout 60 sh -c 'until ss -ltn | grep -q ":3333 "; do sleep 0.2; done'

windows.command: $d = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(60); while (-not (Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 3333 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { if ((Get-Date) -gt $d) { exit 1 }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200 }

tasks.label: Renode: start board
tasks.command: elf=${command:cmake.launchTargetPath}; python3 sim/emulation/gdb_relay.py --listen 3333 --target 3334 & sim/.renode/renode --console -e "\$elf = @$elf; include @sim/emulation/boards/$(basename $elf .elf).resc; machine StartGdbServer 3334"

windows.command: $elf = '${command:cmake.launchTargetPath}' -replace '\\', '/'; $board = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($elf); Start-Process -NoNewWindow -FilePath sim/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -ArgumentList 'sim/emulation/gdb_relay.py', '--listen', '3333', '--target', '3334'; & sim/.renode/renode.exe --console -e "`$elf = @$elf; include @sim/emulation/boards/$board.resc; machine StartGdbServer 3334"

background.endsPattern: GDB server with all CPUs started on port

windows.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessId -ne $PID -and $_.CommandLine -match 'include @.*sim/emulation/board[s]/|sim/emulation/gdb_rela[y]\.py' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; exit 0
